findings.summary: configure_chart(columns=['Measure Names'], measure_values=[...]) renders an empty view.
findings.reproducer: TWBEditor(''); set_excel_connection(...); add_worksheet('V'); configure_chart('V', mark_type='Text', columns=['Measure Names'], measure_values=['SUM(Sales)','SUM(Quantity)']) -> published view CSV is 0 bytes.
findings.isolated_by: The literal 'Measure Names' color registered a physical [Measure Names] column instead of the virtual [:Measure Names], and measure_values was dropped when routing to BasicChartBuilder for Bar/Line/Circle/Square.
findings.workaround: Bind the measures directly on the columns shelf (Bars) or use configure_layered_chart panes (Order Detail, BANs).
findings.upstream_fix: fix(sdk): honor measure values on primitive marks
